sources.title: Akan Civilization and History
sources.author: Kwasi Ampene
sources.description: Scholarly article by Kwasi Ampene (Tufts University) on Akan civilization and history, approached through contemporary African musicological inquiry. Cover article of the special dossier "Etnomusicologia Negra".

sources.title: Indigenous and Exogenous Sources
sources.author: Emmanuel Ababio Ofosu-Mensah, University of Ghana
sources.source: The Journal of African History, vol. 56, no. 3 (2015), pp. 493–494
sources.description: Book review of Kwasi Konadu, "The Akan People: A Documentary History" (Markus Wiener Publishers, 2014). Surveys how Akan history has been reconstructed from indigenous (oral) and exogenous (European/Islamic) written sources, including naming politics, oral traditions, Asante and Fante states and states of knowledge about Akan origins.
